items.title: Leigh Carrole III Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: Well, when I was about 12 years old, I heard for the first time Pop Selstein's band.

ctx.x: When did you first become aware of the existence of such a form of music as New Orleans jazz?
Well, when I was about 12 years old, I heard for the first time Pop Selstein's band. And I believe it was the old Pestridge-Chan Yacht Club.
What did you think of the music?
